title: Vintage Scott US Stamp 1938 4¢ James Madison - Used North Hollywood, CA
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1938 4¢ United States Scott stamp featuring James Madison, a historical figure. The stamp is purple in color and was used in North Hollywood, California. It is ungraded and uncertified, making it a unique and collectible piece for philatelists interested in United States stamps from the early 20th century.
